title: RF Sentinel Command envelope, version 1
description: Everything a station and the hub exchange. Reference implementation and stricter checks: rf_platform/command/envelope.py (validate). Metadata only: IQ samples never travel in an envelope.

id.description: Deterministic per logical event, so redelivery deduplicates.
<hostname>/<arch>. Names the station; authentication is the transport's job.

seq.description: Sender sequence; resets when the sender restarts.

source_time.description: When observed or created, by the station clock.

ttl_s.description: Required for mission_request: expiry measured from source_time.

idempotency_key.description: Required for mission messages: the command id.

payload.description: At most 64 KiB serialized. No IQ sample fields.
